title: Server Addresses
description: Every address this server currently answers on. The panel can add and remove its own; an address configured outside the panel is shown here and left alone.

add.title: Add an address
add.description: The address is put on the interface straight away and recorded so it comes back after a reboot.
add.ipv4Only: IPv4 only. The kernel discards the marker that tells a panel-added IPv6 address apart from the provider's own, so this screen cannot safely take one back.

list.title: Addresses on this server
list.description: Read from the server itself, not from the panel's own records.
list.none: This server has no routable addresses.

remove.confirmBody: {{ip}} is taken off {{interface}} straight away and will not come back after a reboot. Anything reaching this server on it stops working.

error.load: The server's addresses could not be read.
error.add: The address could not be added.
error.remove: The address could not be removed.

reason.server_ip_not_ipv4: Only IPv4 addresses can be managed here.
reason.server_ip_reserved: That address is not one a server can be reached on.
reason.server_ip_bad_prefix: That prefix length is not valid for IPv4.
reason.server_ip_unknown_interface: This server has no interface by that name.
reason.server_ip_already_on_host: That address is already configured on this server.
reason.server_ip_not_added_by_panel: This address was not added by the panel, so the panel will not take it away.
reason.server_ip_in_use_by_panel: The panel is listening on this address.
reason.server_ip_host_unreadable: The server would not answer, so nothing was changed.
reason.server_ip_not_found: There is no record of that address.
reason.server_ip_no_label_available: Every address marker is in use.
